nodes.author: MetabolicUncle
nodes.text: India’s health policies miss the mark by isolating climate change from the body’s metabolic resilience. Extreme weather, air pollutants, and similar stresses unsettle metabolic stability, triggering inflammation that compromises lung defenses and even promotes infections like HMPV. A unified strategy that bolsters both environmental and metabolic defenses would offer more robust protection.
